subject: rstan::stan_model does not give detailed error message

messages.author: 5625046ec843e163
messages.subject: rstan::stan_model does not give detailed error message
parts:
I just updated to the latest version R 3.4.0. It is unclear if this was the reason, but when I compile stan models, the error message I received was simply 

Error in stanc(file = file, model_code = model_code, model_name = model_name,  : 
  c++ exception (unknown reason) 

No details were given as before which makes the debug really difficult. 

Any ideas? Many thanks.

The following was my session:

Running under: macOS Sierra 10.12.4
